summary.content:
Today's selection covers 54 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 27 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Congress’s favorite AI tool? ChatGPT
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Visa to Acquire Fraud Intelligence Firm BioCatch for $2.4 Billion
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, The Verge, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 28 articles published in the last 24 hours
